# Set Up
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
 
Packages <- c("tidyverse", "readxl", "stats", "ggfortify", "ggrepel", "svglite", "pheatmap")

lapply(Packages, library, character.only=TRUE)
```

```{r source_function}
#Source Functions
source("functions.R")
```

```{r set_path}
png_path <- "../../results/untargeted/Batch 2"
svg_path <- "../../results/untargeted/Batch 2/svg"
```

## Load Dataset

```{r LoadDataset, echo=TRUE}
#Peak Area Values
full_dataset = read_excel('../../doc/untargeted/24_untargeted_developing_2025.xlsx',sheet="Area",range=NULL)

#Metabolite Annotations
compound_annotation = read_excel('../../doc/untargeted/24_untargeted_developing_2025.xlsx',sheet="Annotation", range=NULL)

#Sample Metadata
sample_metadata = read_excel('../../doc/untargeted/24_metadata.xlsx',sheet="metadata",range=NULL)
#Rename SampleName to Sample in metadata if needed
sample_metadata <- sample_metadata %>%
  rename(Sample = SampleName)
```

## Format Datafile
```{r data_format, echo=TRUE}
# Clean the data
Batch2_Untargeted_Raw <- clean_metabolomics_data(full_dataset, sample_metadata, compound_annotation, dataset_name = "Batch2_Untargeted_Raw")
```

# Peak Features
## Peak Intensity

```{r long_format}
Batch2_Untargeted_Raw_Long <- prepare_long_data(Batch2_Untargeted_Raw_peak_data, Batch2_Untargeted_Raw_sample_metadata)
```

```{r peak_intensity}
# Peak Intensity
intensity_plots <- plot_all_intensity(
  data_long = Batch2_Untargeted_Raw_Long,
  title_prefix = "Batch2 Raw ",
  png_path = png_path,
  svg_path = svg_path
)
```

## Peak Detection
```{r peak_detection}
peak_detection_df <- calculate_peak_detection(
  dataset = Batch2_Untargeted_Raw_peak_data,
  sample_metadata = Batch2_Untargeted_Raw_sample_metadata,
  sample_cols = 4:27
)

detection_plots <- plot_all_detection(
  peak_detection_df = peak_detection_df,
  title_prefix = "Batch2 Raw ",
  png_path = png_path,
  svg_path = svg_path
)

# Optional: Get a summary
summarize_peak_detection(peak_detection_df)
```

# Abundant Peaks

## Individual Metabolites

```{r calculate_abundance}
  sample_cols = 4:27,
  compound_annotation = Batch2_Untargeted_Raw_compound_annotation
)

metabolite_abundance_by_sex <- calculate_metabolite_abundance_by_group(
  data_long = Batch2_Untargeted_Raw_Long,

)

metabolite_abundance_by_gw <- calculate_metabolite_abundance_by_group(

)

```

```{r abundant_classes}
# Aggregate by Class
class_abundance <- metabolite_abundance_annotated %>%
  filter(!is.na(Class) & Class != "") %>%
  group_by(Class) %>%
  summarise(mean_intensity = mean(mean_intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_metabolites = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_intensity))

# Top 20 Classes - Bar graph
top20_class <- class_abundance %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

ggplot(top20_class, aes(x = reorder(Class, mean_intensity), y = mean_intensity)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Most Abundant Metabolite Classes",
       x = "Class",
       y = "Mean Peak Intensity") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
ggsave("top20_class.svg", path = svg_path, width = 10, height = 8, bg = "transparent")

# Top 100 Classes - Heatmap (aggregate metabolites within each class)
top100_class <- class_abundance %>%
  slice_head(n = 100)

# For each class, aggregate all metabolites in that class per sample
class_heatmap_data <- metabolite_abundance_annotated %>%
  filter(Class %in% top100_class$Class) %>%
  left_join(full_dataset %>% select(Compound.ID, starts_with("Sample")), by = "Compound.ID") %>%
  select(Class, starts_with("Sample")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Sample"), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Intensity") %>%
  group_by(Class, Sample) %>%
  summarise(mean_intensity = mean(Intensity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = mean_intensity) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Class") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Replace NaN with NA
class_heatmap_data[is.nan(class_heatmap_data)] <- NA

class_heatmap_data_log <- log10(class_heatmap_data + 1)

# Replace any remaining Inf values
class_heatmap_data_log[is.infinite(class_heatmap_data_log)] <- NA

# Impute NAs with 1/5th of the minimum value in each row
for(i in 1:nrow(class_heatmap_data_log)) {
  row_data <- class_heatmap_data_log[i, ]
  if(any(is.na(row_data))) {
    min_value <- min(row_data, na.rm = TRUE)
    class_heatmap_data_log[i, is.na(row_data)] <- min_value / 5
  }
}

pheatmap(class_heatmap_data_log,
         scale = "row",
         annotation_col = sample_annotation,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = TRUE,
         main = "Top 100 Most Abundant Metabolite Classes",
         fontsize_row = 6,
         filename = file.path(svg_path, "top100_class_heatmap.png"),
         width = 12, height = 16)

# By Sex
class_abundance_by_sex <- metabolite_abundance_by_sex_annotated %>%
  filter(!is.na(Class) & Class != "") %>%
  group_by(Class, Sex) %>%
  summarise(mean_intensity = mean(mean_intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_metabolites = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Sex, desc(mean_intensity))

top20_class_by_sex <- class_abundance_by_sex %>%
  group_by(Sex) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(top20_class_by_sex, aes(x = reorder(Class, mean_intensity), y = mean_intensity, fill = Sex)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~Sex, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Most Abundant Metabolite Classes by Sex",
       x = "Class",
       y = "Mean Peak Intensity") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))
ggsave("top20_class_by_sex.svg", path = svg_path, width = 14, height = 10, bg = "transparent")

# Across GW buckets
class_abundance_by_GW <- metabolite_abundance_by_GW_annotated %>%
  filter(!is.na(Class) & Class != "") %>%
  group_by(Class, GW_bucket) %>%
  summarise(mean_intensity = mean(mean_intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_metabolites = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(GW_bucket, desc(mean_intensity))

top20_class_by_GW <- class_abundance_by_GW %>%
  group_by(GW_bucket) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(top20_class_by_GW, aes(x = reorder(Class, mean_intensity), y = mean_intensity, fill = GW_bucket)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~GW_bucket, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Most Abundant Metabolite Classes by Gestational Week",
       x = "Class",
       y = "Mean Peak Intensity") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))
ggsave("top20_class_by_GW.svg", path = svg_path, width = 18, height = 10, bg = "transparent")

# By Sex

top20_subclass_by_sex <- subclass_abundance_by_sex %>%

ggplot(top20_subclass_by_sex, aes(x = reorder(Sub.Class, mean_intensity), y = mean_intensity, fill = Sex)) +
```

## Retention Time

```{r retention_time}
## RETENTION TIME ANALYSIS ##

# Add retention time to metabolite abundance data
metabolite_abundance_with_RT <- metabolite_abundance_annotated %>%
  left_join(compound_annotation %>% select(Compound.ID, `RT[min]`), by = "Compound.ID") %>%
  rename(RT = `RT[min]`)

# Distribution of retention time across samples - Histogram
ggplot(metabolite_abundance_with_RT, aes(x = RT)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Retention Time Across Samples",
       x = "Retention Time (min)",
       y = "Count") +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10))
ggsave("RT_distribution_histogram.svg", path = svg_path, width = 10, height = 6, bg = "transparent")

# By Sex
metabolite_abundance_by_sex_with_RT <- metabolite_abundance_by_sex_annotated %>%
  left_join(compound_annotation %>% select(Compound.ID, `RT[min]`), by = "Compound.ID") %>%
  rename(RT = `RT[min]`)

ggplot(metabolite_abundance_by_sex_with_RT, aes(x = RT, fill = Sex)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, color = "black", position = "identity", alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Retention Time by Sex",
       x = "Retention Time (min)",
       y = "Count") +
  facet_wrap(~Sex, ncol = 1)
ggsave("RT_distribution_by_sex.svg", path = svg_path, width = 10, height = 8, bg = "transparent")

# Over gestational week - Line graph
# Calculate mean RT per GW
metabolite_abundance_by_GW_with_RT <- metabolite_abundance_by_GW_annotated %>%
  left_join(compound_annotation %>% select(Compound.ID, `RT[min]`), by = "Compound.ID") %>%
  rename(RT = `RT[min]`)

# Aggregate by GW bucket
RT_by_GW <- metabolite_abundance_by_GW_with_RT %>%
  group_by(GW_bucket) %>%
  summarise(mean_RT = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_RT = sd(RT, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(),
            se_RT = sd_RT / sqrt(n),
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(RT_by_GW, aes(x = GW_bucket, y = mean_RT, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(size = 1, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_RT - se_RT, ymax = mean_RT + se_RT), width = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Mean Retention Time Over Gestational Week",
       x = "Gestational Week",
       y = "Mean Retention Time (min)")
ggsave("RT_over_GW.svg", path = svg_path, width = 10, height = 6, bg = "transparent")

# Time x Intensity Scatter plot per column for class
# First, extract column from Compound.ID
metabolite_RT_intensity_class <- metabolite_abundance_with_RT %>%
  filter(!is.na(Class) & Class != "" & !is.na(RT)) %>%
  mutate(Column = sub("-[^-]+-[0-9]+$", "", Compound.ID))  # Extract column from Compound.ID

# Get top 10 classes for plotting
top_classes <- metabolite_RT_intensity_class %>%
  group_by(Class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Class)

metabolite_RT_intensity_class_top <- metabolite_RT_intensity_class %>%
  filter(Class %in% top_classes)

ggplot(metabolite_RT_intensity_class_top, aes(x = RT, y = mean_intensity, color = Class)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~Column, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Retention Time vs Intensity by Column (Top 10 Classes)",
       x = "Retention Time (min)",
       y = "Mean Peak Intensity") +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
ggsave("RT_vs_intensity_by_column_class.svg", path = svg_path, width = 14, height = 10, bg = "transparent")

# Time x Intensity Scatter plot per column for subclass
metabolite_RT_intensity_subclass <- metabolite_abundance_with_RT %>%
  filter(!is.na(Sub.Class) & Sub.Class != "" & !is.na(RT)) %>%
  mutate(Column = sub("-[^-]+-[0-9]+$", "", Compound.ID))

# Get top 10 subclasses for plotting
top_subclasses <- metabolite_RT_intensity_subclass %>%
  group_by(Sub.Class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Sub.Class)

metabolite_RT_intensity_subclass_top <- metabolite_RT_intensity_subclass %>%
  filter(Sub.Class %in% top_subclasses)

ggplot(metabolite_RT_intensity_subclass_top, aes(x = RT, y = mean_intensity, color = Sub.Class)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~Column, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Retention Time vs Intensity by Column (Top 10 Subclasses)",
       x = "Retention Time (min)",
       y = "Mean Peak Intensity") +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
ggsave("RT_vs_intensity_by_column_subclass.svg", path = svg_path, width = 14, height = 10, bg = "transparent")
```

## Initial PCA

```{r PCA_One, echo = TRUE}
# PCA of sample variation
# Prepare data for PCA (samples as rows, metabolites as columns)
samples_matrix <- full_dataset %>%
  select(starts_with("Sample")) %>%
  t()

# 1/5th min value imputation
samples_matrix <- apply(samples_matrix, 2, min_value_impute)

# Perform PCA
pca_samples <- prcomp(samples_matrix, scale. = TRUE)

# Convert PCA results to data frame and add Sample labels
sample_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_samples$x)
sample_scores$Sample <- rownames(sample_scores)

# Merge sample scores with metadata
sample_scores <- sample_scores %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = "Sample")

# Calculate variance explained
var_explained_samples <- pca_samples$sdev^2 / sum(pca_samples$sdev^2) * 100

# Create Elbow Plot
elbow_data <- data.frame(
  PC = 1:length(var_explained_samples),
  VarExp = var_explained_samples
)

ggplot(elbow_data, aes(x = PC, y = VarExp)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Principal Component",
       y = "Variance Explained (%)",
       title = "Scree Plot of PCA Variance Explained by Samples") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
ggsave("raw_sample_elbow.svg", path = svg_path)

# Plot PCA for samples
ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Sample), size = 3) +
  geom_text(vjust = -1, hjust = -0.1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]), title = "PCA of Sample Variation")
ggsave("raw_sample_pca.svg", path = svg_path)

# Sex PCA
ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Sex, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]),
       title = "Sample PCA by Sex") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("F" = "#FF69B4", "M" = "#4169E1")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
ggsave("raw_sample_pca1x2_sex.svg", path = svg_path)

ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3, color = Sex, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]),
       y = sprintf("PC3 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[3]),
       title = "Sample PCA by Sex") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("F" = "#FF69B4", "M" = "#4169E1")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
ggsave("raw_sample_pca2x3_sex.svg", path = svg_path)

# GW PCA
ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = GW, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]),
       title = "Sample PCA by Gestational Week") +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
ggsave("raw_sample_pca1x2_gw.svg", path = svg_path)

ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3, color = GW, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]),
       y = sprintf("PC3 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[3]),
       title = "Sample PCA by Gestational Week") +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
ggsave("raw_sample_pca2x3_gw.svg", path = svg_path)

# PCA of metabolite variation
# Prepare data for PCA (metabolites as rows, samples as columns)
metabolites_matrix <- full_dataset %>%
  select(starts_with("Sample"))

metabolites_matrix <- apply(metabolites_matrix, 2, min_value_impute)

# Perform PCA
pca_metabolites <- prcomp(metabolites_matrix, scale. = TRUE)

# Convert PCA results to data frame and add metabolite labels
metabolite_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_metabolites$x)
metabolite_scores$Compound.ID <- full_dataset$Compound.ID

# Calculate variance explained
var_explained_metabolites <- pca_metabolites$sdev^2 / sum(pca_metabolites$sdev^2) * 100

# Create Elbow Plot
elbow_data <- data.frame(
  PC = 1:length(var_explained_metabolites),
  VarExp = var_explained_metabolites
)

ggplot(elbow_data, aes(x = PC, y = VarExp)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Principal Component",
       y = "Variance Explained (%)",
       title = "Scree Plot of PCA Variance Explained by Metabolites") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
ggsave("raw_metabolite_elbow.svg", path = svg_path)

# Calculate distance from origin for each metabolite
metabolite_scores <- metabolite_scores %>%
  mutate(distance = sqrt(PC1^2 + PC2^2))

# Define a threshold for labeling outliers.
# This threshold can be adjusted based on the spread of your data.
threshold <- quantile(metabolite_scores$distance, 0.99)

# Create a logical column to indicate if the metabolite is an outlier
metabolite_scores <- metabolite_scores %>%
  mutate(is_outlier = distance > threshold)

# Plot PCA for metabolites with outlier labels
ggplot(metabolite_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is_outlier, Compound.ID, "")), vjust = -1, hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_metabolites[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_metabolites[2]), 
       title = "PCA of Metabolite Variation") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
ggsave("raw_metabolite_pca1x2.svg", path = svg_path)

ggplot(metabolite_scores, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is_outlier, Compound.ID, "")), vjust = -1, hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_metabolites[2]),
       y = sprintf("PC3 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_metabolites[3]), 
       title = "PCA of Metabolite Variation") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
ggsave("raw_metabolite_pca2x3.svg", path = svg_path)
```
